== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Imperial Gunner (Japanese)|Imperial Gunner]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/150138986/_A7N_500Dk6GLZveExJuIw.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 84363904.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 635, 1287, 2210)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>0be93ec3e1156e415317bc77d83f2381630ca04da7dd5ae4b7406febac9c16cd</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
